summary: Dryad dataset 10.5061/dryad.vx0k6djrp (CC0) compiles mass and growth-rate change across larval transitions and metamorphosis for 105 species of fish, amphibians, insects, crustaceans and molluscs, which is the cross-taxon pre/post comparison the operationalizations ask for; Add-my-Pet supplies per-species weight-at-age series around pupation/metamorphosis for eel, silkworm and frog as supplements.
next_step: Download dryad.vx0k6djrp, identify the metamorphosis-transition rows and the pre/post mass columns, and pre-register the frequency of net mass loss by group with a check on whether wet or dry mass was recorded.
obstacles_confirmed: Weight series through metamorphosis are scattered across experimental papers (the Dryad compilation is itself a literature synthesis).
Hydration and gut evacuation controls are not indicated in the dataset metadata.
